From: naomi.feldman@redwood-inference.com

Date: 2027-06-20T10:05:00-04:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II report request

Hi Samir —

Thanks for the note. We're happy to share our SOC 2 Type II package. Two quick items up-front:

1) Audit period: our latest Type II report covers 2026-10-01 through 2027-03-31. If you need a bridge letter to confirm controls remain in place through a later cutoff, we provide a short signed bridge letter (PDF) summarizing interim coverage and any notable changes.

2) Transfer options: we can deliver a package via SFTP (preferred for large exports), a time-limited OneDrive/SharePoint link, or an encrypted zip via our secure transfer workflow. See attached "secure-share-instructions.txt" for the SFTP path and credentials flow (we'll create a temporary account and rotate creds after transfer).

I've attached a minimal evidence checklist (CSV) and a sample bridge letter options PDF to speed review. Below I've pasted three short reply templates you can forward internally to the security/procurement reviewers — one-liners for (a) SOC 2 report delivery, (b) bridge letter option, and (c) limited redaction / audit-era notes. Feel free to use as-is.

What we'll include in the package (standard):
- SOC 2 Type II report (PDF)
- Bridge letter (if requested)
- Controls summary mapping (services scoped: Redwood API hosted + Dedicated pools)
- Minimal evidence index (CSV) with delivery pointers
- Contact list for audit follow-ups (security@redwood-inference.com)

Notes specific to inference products: we do not retain full-text customer inputs beyond 30 days for hosted accounts unless contractually configured; token-level telemetry (latency/cost) is retained for 90 days for operational diagnostics. If your audit team needs sample telemetry slices, let us know the timeframe and we can provide redacted extracts.

Short reply templates (copy/paste):
(a) SOC 2 report delivery
"Redwood Inference has provided their SOC 2 Type II report for the period 2026-10-01 to 2027-03-31. Requested package can be downloaded from the secure SFTP (sftp://files.redwood-inference.com/nimbus_health/) or via a time-limited OneDrive link. For questions: security@redwood-inference.com."

(b) Bridge letter option
"If you require coverage beyond the report period, Redwood offers a signed bridge letter summarizing maintained controls and notable updates since the report end date; please indicate the desired cutoff date and we will generate the letter."

(c) Minimal redaction / evidence note
"Redwood will provide control-level artifacts and redacted sample logs where necessary; any PII will be redacted and transfer will be via encrypted channels per our secure-share instructions."

If that works, I'll coordinate SFTP account creation and send a delivery ETA (typically within 24 hours). Do you need the bridge letter to reference a specific cutoff (e.g., 2027-06-30)?

Thanks,

Naomi Feldman
Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood-inference.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: soc2_typeii_minimal_ask.csv, bridge_letter_options.pdf, secure-share-instructions.txt
